title: AngularLynx add-tailwind schematic
description: Adds Tailwind CSS to an existing AngularLynx project: Tailwind 4 by default, or Tailwind 3 with @lynx-js/tailwind-preset.

project.description: The name of the project to add Tailwind CSS to.

tailwindVersion.description: The Tailwind CSS major version to set up: 4 (with @tailwindcss/postcss), or 3 (with @lynx-js/tailwind-preset). Defaults to the version the project already depends on, else 4.
